# The import timeout increase is separate from the later sparse ZIP fixture

This landing only changes requestLongerTimeout(2) to requestLongerTimeout(3). Its test fixture still writes four half-gigabyte chunks plus two bytes. Fixed accepted source later creates a sparse file with a seek and one-byte write, and uses multiplier 2 again. Keep the temporary test budget and later fixture optimization as separate phases; neither source inspection nor the timeout increase establishes a passing import run.

Scope: Profile import browser-test budget.
